Question:
An isosceles triangle has a vertex angle of \(40^\circ\). What is the measure of a base angle? (Unit: degrees; enter a number)

[Figure 1](figures/cnm_137_q1_question_en.svg)
Solution: The two base angles are equal, so a base angle is \((180^\circ-40^\circ)\div2=70^\circ\).
